namespace = cosmo_asiapu_events


# Royal Marriage yura Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_asiapu_events.17103
	title = cosmo_asiapu_events.17103.t
	desc = cosmo_asiapu_events.17103.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_17A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_known_country = {
				limit = {
					has_opinion_modifier = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
					}
				}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}
				random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

			OR = {
				primary_culture = yura
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = proposalcountry
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.17103.a 
		trigger = {
		has_regency = no 	
		OR = {
			has_consort = no	
			has_estate = estate_harem 	
			has_estate = estate_wives 	
			has_estate = estate_forbiddenpalace 	
			has_estate = estate_ooku 				
		}
		}
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.171098
			}
		}				
	}
		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.17103.b 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.171098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		option = {#uncleson
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.17103.c 
		trigger = {
			has_heir = yes
		NOT = {
			has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
		}
		}
		add_ruler_modifier = {
			name = cosmo_heir_married
			duration = -1  
			desc = cosmo_heir_married_DESC

				}		
		set_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
		#proposal country
		country_event = {#royal wedding FROM
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.171098
			}
		}
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}	
		option = {#reject
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.17103.7 
		event_target:proposalcountry = {
			remove_opinion = {
					who = ROOT
					modifier = cosmo_sending_proposal
				}
		}						
	}
		
}

# Royal Marriage yura Subject
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_asiapu_events.17101
	title = cosmo_asiapu_events.17101.t
	desc = cosmo_asiapu_events.17101.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_17A_1_eventPicture

	is_triggered_only = yes		

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = china_superregion
				superregion = east_indies_superregion
				superregion = oceania_superregion
				superregion = far_east_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
		}
		every_subject_country = {
		every_owned_province = {
			limit = {
			OR = {
				superregion = china_superregion
				superregion = east_indies_superregion
				superregion = oceania_superregion
				superregion = far_east_superregion
				superregion = india_superregion
			}	
			}
			set_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
		}			
		}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}				
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_province = {
				limit = {
					has_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 2
					has_port = yes 					
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_subject_country = {
				limit = {
					capital_scope = {
						superregion = china_superregion
						has_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_possible_here
					}
				}
				capital_scope = {
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}	
				}										
		}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.17101.a 
		FROM = {
			capital_scope = { #testdelete
			set_province_flag = yura_honeymoon_first_stop	
			}
		}
		create_marriage = FROM
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}				
		define_consort = {
			country_of_origin = FROM
			dynasty = FROM
			religion = FROM
			culture = FROM
			female = yes
		}
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_palace_17a
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				FROM = {
					NOT = {
				cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes
					}
				}				
				}
				create_subject = { 
					subject_type = cosmo_asian_personal_union_I	
					subject = FROM	
					}
				join_all_offensive_wars_of = FROM
				join_all_defensive_wars_of = FROM	
				FROM = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						has_reform = pirate_republic_reform
					}
					hidden_effect = {
					change_government = monarchy 
					}
					add_government_reform = cosmo_pirate_kingdom 					
				}
				}	
			}
				country_event = {#honeymoon first
					id = cosmo_asiapu_events.171031
					days = 30
					random = 15					
					}
		hidden_effect = {
				trigger_switch = {
		on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
		royal_marriage_ruler = {
			set_country_flag = yura_ruler_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_ruler
			}
		cosmo_heir_married = {
			set_country_flag = yura_heir_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_heir
			}
		royal_marriage_uncleson = {
			set_country_flag = yura_uncle_honeymoon
			clr_ruler_flag = royal_marriage_uncleson
			}
		}
		}			
	}		
}

		}

			}

	id = cosmo_asiapu_events.172019
	title = cosmo_asiapu_events.172019.t
	desc = cosmo_asiapu_events.172019.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_17B_1_eventPicture

	
	trigger = {
		ai = no
		has_country_flag = maori_heir_honeymoon
	NOT = {
		has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
	}
		}

	
		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 7
		}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = maori_heir_honeymoon
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

			OR = {
				primary_culture = maori
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.172019.a 
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

			OR = {
				primary_culture = maori
			}
			}
				overlord = {
					define_consort = {
						country_of_origin = PREV
						religion = PREV
						culture = PREV
					}
				}
		}		
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_palace_17b
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceSeventeenBCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceSeventeenBCounter	
			value = 280
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceSeventeenBCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}	
}

country_event = {
	id = cosmo_asiapu_events.191019
	title = cosmo_asiapu_events.191019.t
	desc = cosmo_asiapu_events.191019.d
	picture = cosmogfx_PALACE_MENU_19A_1_eventPicture

	
	trigger = {
		ai = no
		has_country_flag = palawa_heir_honeymoon
	NOT = {
		has_ruler_modifier = cosmo_heir_married
	}
		}

	
		mean_time_to_happen = {
			days = 7
		}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
		clr_country_flag = palawa_heir_honeymoon
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

			OR = {
				primary_culture = palawa
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.191019.a 
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

			OR = {
				primary_culture = palawa
			}
			}
				overlord = {
					define_consort = {
						country_of_origin = PREV
						religion = PREV
						culture = PREV
					}
				}
		}		
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_consort
		set_consort_flag = cosmo_palace_19a
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceNineteenACounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceNineteenACounter	
			value = 580
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceNineteenACounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}	
}

						}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_adm_power = 1 	
						}
						}																
						}

							name = cosmo_fertile_ruler
							duration = -1  
							desc = cosmo_fertile_ruler_DESC
							hidden = no				
						}
					}																
				}

					honeymoon_ruler_bonus = {
						set_ruler_flag = has_honeymoon_monarchpoints
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
							change_dip = 1				
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
							change_adm = 1				
						}																		
						}
					honeymoon_province_bonus = {
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_dip_power = 1 	
						}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_adm_power = 1 	
						}
						}																
						}
					honeymoon_fertility_bonus = {
						add_ruler_modifier = {
							name = cosmo_fertile_ruler
							duration = -1  
							desc = cosmo_fertile_ruler_DESC
							hidden = no				
						}
					}																
				}	
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
				every_province = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_second_stop
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_third_stop
						}
					}
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_chosen_here
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_second_stop
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_third_stop
				}				
			}					
	}

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {
				random_province = {

					country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 
				}
					save_event_target_as = honeymoonprovince
				}
				random_list = {
				25 = { #adm
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				}
				25 = { #dip
					trigger = {
					NOT = {
						has_ruler_flag = has_honeymoon_monarchpoints
					}						
					}
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
	
				}
				25 = { #mil
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				}
				25 = { #mil
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_fertility_bonus
				}																								
			}
				random_list = {
				33 = { #adm
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				}
				33 = { #dip
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
	
				}
				33 = { #mil
						set_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
				}																								
			}								
	}
	}	

		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.203041.a 
		trigger = {
			has_consort = yes		
				}
		if = {
			limit = {
			has_global_flag = cosmo_buildings_active
			}
			custom_tooltip = royal_visit_building_hmoonactive_tt
		}		
		event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
				name = honeymoon_visit
				duration = 90 
				desc = honeymoon_visit_DESC
	
			}
		}										
				trigger_switch = {
					on_trigger = has_ruler_flag
					honeymoon_consort_bonus = {
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1	
						}
						remove_queen_personality = zealot_personality  
						add_queen_personality = tolerant_personality 
						}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2	
						}
						remove_queen_personality = babbling_buffoon_personality  
						remove_queen_personality = naive_personality  
						add_queen_personality = silver_tongue_personality
						}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3	
						}
						remove_queen_personality = infertile_personality  
						add_queen_personality = fertile_personality
						}										
					}
					honeymoon_ruler_bonus = {
						set_ruler_flag = has_honeymoon_monarchpoints
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
							change_dip = 1				
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
							change_adm = 1				
						}																		
						}
					honeymoon_province_bonus = {
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_dip_power = 1 	
						}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_adm_power = 1 	
						}
						}																
						}
					honeymoon_fertility_bonus = {
						add_ruler_modifier = {
							name = cosmo_fertile_ruler
							duration = -1  
							desc = cosmo_fertile_ruler_DESC
							hidden = no				
						}
					}																
				}	
			country_event = { 
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.203042
			    days = 30
				random = 15
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
			}
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter	
			value = 600
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}
	}					
	}
		option = {#end early
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.203041.b
		remove_country_modifier = cosmo_on_honeymoon 
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
				every_province = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
						}
					}
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
				}
			}
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter	
			value = 600
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}
	}										
	}

			limit = {
				event_target:personalunion = {
				NOT = {
					any_owned_province = {
						has_port = yes
					NOT = {
						has_trade_modifier = {
							who = ROOT
							key = cosmo_trade_goods
						}
					}	
					}
				}			
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = cosmo_pu_has_trademodifier_tt
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				any_province = {
				country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT 	
					OR = {
				trade_goods = gold
				trade_goods = wine
				trade_goods = fur
				trade_goods = salt
				trade_goods = ivory
				trade_goods = cotton
				trade_goods = cocoa
				trade_goods = gems
				trade_goods = sugar
				trade_goods = tropical_wood
				trade_goods = tobacco
					}
				base_production = 3 									
					}				
				event_target:personalunion = {
				OR = {
					development_in_provinces = {
						value = 50
						country_or_vassal_holds = ROOT
					}
					province_has_center_of_trade_of_level = 1			
				}			
					any_owned_province = {
						has_port = yes
					NOT = {
						has_trade_modifier = {
							who = ROOT
							key = cosmo_trade_goods
						}
					}	
					}			
				}
			}
				custom_tooltip = cosmo_trade_mission_reward_tt 		
				event_target:personalunion = {			
					remove_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_send_economic_mission
					}
					add_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_send_trade_mission
					}						
				}
		country_event = {
			id = cosmo_asiapu_events.20360
			}				
		}
		event_target:personalunion = {			
				hidden_effect = {
					remove_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_send_economic_mission
					}
				}						
		}					
	}
		option = {#cancel
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.20306.7 
		event_target:personalunion = {			
				hidden_effect = {
					remove_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_send_economic_mission
					}
				}						
		}		
	}					
}

		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.203013.a

					mil_power = 50					
				}

					advisor = quartermaster 	
					advisor = recruitmaster 	
					advisor = fortification_expert 	 	
				}
					mil_power = 50					
			}
			add_mil_power = -50	
			event_target:personalunion = {
				add_mil_power = 50
				country_event = {
					id = cosmo_sendmiladvisor_events.1
					}																												
				add_liberty_desire = -15
				add_trust = {
					who = ROOT
					value = 15
					mutual = yes
				}			
			}
		}
		event_target:personalunion = {			
				hidden_effect = {
					remove_opinion = {
						who = ROOT
						modifier = cosmo_sending_military_aid
					}
				}						
		}				
	}	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.203013.b
		trigger = {
		event_target:personalunion = {
			capital_scope = {
				NOT = {
			has_province_modifier = cosmo_fortifications
				}
			}
		}			
		}
		add_mil_power = -100
		event_target:personalunion = {
			add_trust = {
				who = ROOT
				value = 15
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					liberty_desire = 25
				}
				add_liberty_desire = -15			
			}						
		add_mil_power = 100
			capital_scope = {
			add_province_modifier = { 
			name = cosmo_fortifications
			duration =  18250

			}
			}
			remove_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_sending_military_aid
			}			
		}		
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {

		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {

			value = 600
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}
		option = {#send troops
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.203013.c
		trigger = {
		event_target:personalunion = {
		NOT = {
			has_country_modifier = cosmo_foreign_training
		}	
		}			
		}
		custom_tooltip = cosmo_training_troops_decision_tt

		if = {
			limit = {
				mil_tech = 7 
			}
			set_country_flag = cosmo_has_artillery
		}
		add_mil_power = -50
		add_manpower = 10
		event_target:personalunion = {
		add_mil_power = 50
			add_trust = {
				who = ROOT
				value = 5
				mutual = yes
			}	
			hidden_effect = {
			remove_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_sending_military_aid
			}					
			add_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_training_army
			}	
			}		
		}		
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter	
			value = 600
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}
		option = {#Build Ships
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.203013.7
		trigger = {
		event_target:personalunion = {
			any_owned_province = {
				has_port = yes
			}
		NOT = {
			has_country_modifier = cosmo_foreign_ships
		}	
		}			
		}
		custom_tooltip = cosmo_building_ships_decision_tt 
		add_dip_power = -100
		add_sailors = 500
		event_target:personalunion = {
		add_dip_power = 100
			hidden_effect = {
			remove_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_sending_military_aid
			}
			add_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_building_ships
			}
			}						
		}		
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter	
			value = 600
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}
		option = {#cancel
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.203013.8
		event_target:personalunion = {
			hidden_effect = {
			remove_opinion = {
				who = ROOT
				modifier = cosmo_sending_military_aid
			}	
			}					
		}		
		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter	
			value = 600
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyCCounter
		value = 0
			}
		}

	}

						}
						remove_queen_personality = zealot_personality  
						add_queen_personality = tolerant_personality 
						}
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2

						add_queen_personality = silver_tongue_personality

						limit = {
							has_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3	
						}
						remove_queen_personality = infertile_personality  
						add_queen_personality = fertile_personality
						}										
					}
					honeymoon_ruler_bonus = {
						set_ruler_flag = has_honeymoon_monarchpoints
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
							change_dip = 1				
						}

							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
							change_adm = 1				
						}																		
						}
					honeymoon_province_bonus = {

							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_dip_power = 1 	
						}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_adm_power = 1 	
						}
						}																
						}
					honeymoon_fertility_bonus = {
						add_ruler_modifier = {
							name = cosmo_fertile_ruler
							duration = -1  
							desc = cosmo_fertile_ruler_DESC
							hidden = no				
						}
					}																
				}

				random = 15
			}

				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
			}

				primary_culture = yi
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion

		}

						}

					honeymoon_ruler_bonus = {
						set_ruler_flag = has_honeymoon_monarchpoints
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
							change_dip = 1				
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
							change_adm = 1				
						}																		
						}
					honeymoon_province_bonus = {
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							controller = {
								is_subject_of = ROOT
							} 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_dip_power = 1 	
						}
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
							event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							owned_by = ROOT 	
						}	
							}
						event_target:honeymoonprovince = {
							add_scaled_local_adm_power = 1 	
						}
						}																
						}
					honeymoon_fertility_bonus = {
						add_ruler_modifier = {
							name = cosmo_fertile_ruler
							duration = -1  
							desc = cosmo_fertile_ruler_DESC
							hidden = no				
						}
					}																
				}	
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_consort_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_ruler_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_province_bonus
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_1
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_2
				clr_ruler_flag = honeymoon_bonus_3
				every_province = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_second_stop
							has_province_flag = honeymoon_third_stop
						}
					}
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_chosen_here
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_possible_here
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_first_stop
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_second_stop
					clr_province_flag = honeymoon_third_stop
				}				
			}					
	}

		}

		}

			OR = {
				primary_culture = khazak
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_asiapu_events.231019.a 
		random_subject_country = {
			limit = {
		cosmo_asian_personal_union_subject_trigger = yes

			OR = {
				primary_culture = khazak
			}
			}

						country_of_origin = PREV

					}
				}

		hidden_effect = {
		change_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyThreeACounter
		value = 20
		}
		if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceTwentyThreeACounter	
			value = 580
			}
			}
		set_variable = {
		which = cosmoPalaceTwentyThreeACounter
		value = 0
			}
		}	
		}			
	}

		}

				primary_culture = oirats
			}
			}
					save_event_target_as = personalunion
					capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = pucapital }	
		}
		}
	}

		}
		if = {

			check_variable = {
			which = cosmoPalaceTwentyFourBCounter	
			value = 280
			}
			}
